newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has finalised a plan to set up Dhaka Electric Supply Company which will pave the way for gradual privatisation of the capital city's power supply and billing.
The Parbatya Chattagram Jana Sanghati Samity (PCJSS), the political arm of tribal insurgents in Chittagong Hill Tracts, has proposed resumption of peace talks with the government.
Police have started confiscating movable properties of the retired army officers, involved in the August 1975 coup and killing of independecne leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, who are absconding.

Bangladesh's readymade garments, which enjoy Generalised System of Preference (GSP) facility in EU countries, face problems in continuity of the treatment following allegations of its abuse. A home delegation left Dhaka on Tuesday for Brussels to persuade European Union officials to continue the facility.
The government was stressing on quick privatisation of the container handling facilities in Chittagong Port, port officials said.
